extraction_notes: The BZT52C5V1 row transcribes VZ min/nom/max = 4.85/5.1/5.36 V at IZT = 5 mA, ZZT = 60 ohm at IZT, ZZK = 480 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, IR = 2 microA at VR = 2.0 V, and admissible zener current IZM = 5 mA.

The characteristic curve points are manual digitizations of the plotted 5.1 V curve at the labeled 0.5 mA, 1 mA, and 10 mA grid levels in Fig. 1; they are approximate readings from the plot and were not interpolated.
No diode capacitance value or capacitance test table is provided for the individual BZT52C5V1 part; the generic series capacitance plot is not transcribed as a part-specific numeric spec.
Reverse recovery time is not published in the supplied datasheet.
The datasheet gives a maximum forward-voltage rating of 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA, rather than a typical forward-voltage characteristic table for this part.
